message:
Fixed. "Crème brûlée recipes" now slugs to `creme-brulee-recipes`, and `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including the accented-letter test that was failing.

The fix is one line in `src/blog/slug.js`. The vendored `slugify` deletes any character outside `a-z0-9`, so `è` and `û` disappeared. The wrapper now decomposes accented letters (NFD), strips the combining marks, and then calls `slugify`. I didn't touch `vendor/`.

Two things to know:

- **`src/shop/product-url.js` has the same bug.** It calls `slugify` directly, so product names with accents lose those letters too. I left it alone to keep this change small. If you want it fixed, the same normalization would work there, or the helper could move into a shared module.
- **Not committed.** The change is only in the working tree.
